name: Open a member sub account
description: Opens a new sub account of a given type for a member, with an opening deposit, and returns the suffix the system assigned.
goal: open a {{inputs.accountType}} sub account for the member whose member ID is {{inputs.memberId}}, with an opening amount of {{inputs.openingAmount}}, and record the suffix the system assigns as the output suffix.

inputs.name: accountType
inputs.description: The kind of sub account to open
